'''XT-9T''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] at the [[Imperial base camp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It recruited Imperial operatives for [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ilyan Regus]] after [[Darth Malgus]] betrayed the Empire and established his [[New Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
XT-9T appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the courier for "An Empire Betrayed," the Imperial faction mission that continues the Ilum planetary storyline and sends players to complete the Flashpoints "The Battle of Ilum" and "The False Emperor."<ref name="TOR" />
